# AuraGlass 5.0

> Glass-native component system for React 19 + Next 16 / Vite. Components:
> pending · registry blocks: pending · tarball: pending

## Start

- Quickstart: docs/quickstart/next.md · docs/quickstart/vite.md
- Install: `npm install aura-glass@^5` then `npx @auraglass/cli init`
- Add a block: `npx @auraglass/cli add <name>`

## Imports

- Components: `import { Button, Card, Tabs } from 'aura-glass'`
- Theme + preferences: `aura-glass/theme`
- Tokens/motion: `aura-glass/tokens` · `aura-glass/motion`
- Styles: `import 'aura-glass/styles.css'` (layer `ag`), `aura-glass/tailwind.css`

## Conventions

- Registry items are shadcn-format; base item `auraglass` emits the
  `--background`/`--foreground`/`--primary`/`--border`/`--ring`/`--radius`
  bridge aliases onto `--ag-*` tokens.
- Container queries, never viewport classes, inside blocks/items.
- Unresolved claims read `pending` — never invented numbers.

See llms-full.txt for the expanded index.
